items.source: Class for creating Function callbacks around elicitation methods. This class provides a way to convert methods annotated with McpElicitation into callback functions that can be used to handle elicitation requests. It supports methods with a single ElicitRequest parameter.
items.translation: 用于围绕引出方法创建函数回调的类。 该类提供了一种将带有 McpElicitation 注解的方法转换为可用于处理引出请求的回调函数的方法。它支持具有单个 ElicitRequest 参数的方法。
